text:
mina-solutions: Heads up — onboarding Helix Gateway pilot with their gateway-mux this week. They need help with: grpc multiplexing + our streaming SDK, consistent telemetry labels across multiplexed streams, SSO/ephemeral creds integration, and a procurement SOC2 questionnaire. Also asking for pricing guidance for bursty QPS (spiky traffic). Can someone share a minimal runbook + code samples?

ben-sales: Timeline? they want a demo Thurs afternoon. Are they on Hosted API or Reserved/Dedicated?

mina-solutions: Hosted first, but they may move to Dedicated if the throughput looks good. Demo = Thurs 3pm PT.

raj-eng: Quick notes on grpc-mux + streaming SDK: our streaming endpoint supports multiplexed logical streams over a single websocket connection. For JS SDK, pass grpcMux: true + streamId per logical stream. Example (very minimal):
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, grpcMux: true });
const s = client.stream({ model: 'gpt-4o-infer', streamId: 'helix-1' });
s.on('data', chunk => console.log('payload', chunk));
// open another logical stream on same transport
const s2 = client.stream({ model: 'gpt-4o-infer', streamId: 'helix-2' });
```
Fallback: if the gateway can't support websocket muxing, open independent connections or use non-streaming request/response.

raj-eng: For telemetry labels, include these per logical stream: service=helix, stream_id, customer_id, demo_tag. We automatically pipe these to the console traces if you set trace: true on the stream.

anne-devex: For structured output + tool calling, show them a short function-call example so they can validate schema quickly. Example payload we use in demos: 
```json
{"action":"call_tool","tool":"extract_entities","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string"},"amount":{"type":"number"}},"required":["name"]}}
```
We also recommend they send a small validation set (5-10 prompts) so Optimize can catch regressions.

sec-bot: SOC2 questionnaire — please ask procurement to send the vendor questionnaire PDF to security@redwood.ai. Short blockers: (1) need point-of-contact for data flow diagrams, (2) confirm whether PII will be logged to their side, (3) if Dedicated required we need KMS/HSM details. We can usually turn around the questionnaire in 3–5 business days after receiving docs.

mina-solutions: Pricing: they explicitly asked about bursty spikes (short lived 5k QPS bursts). Any ballpark for hosted bursting?

ben-sales: Ballpark for hosted: sustained small traffic is pay-as-you-go. For bursts that big we usually recommend a short-term dedicated reservation or burst add-on. Example: a small dedicated slice to cover bursts ~ $6k–12k/mo depending on GPU family, or hosted burst add-on negotiated case-by-case. For the demo, offer to simulate 2k QPS sustained for 10 minutes as a proof-run and then provide a formal estimate.

raj-eng: Operational checklist for demo:
- Provide ephemeral API key for demo (set to demo workspace)
- Enable grpcMux in client and set trace:true
- Share expected payload sizes and max token length (we tune batching kernels accordingly)
- If they use SAML SSO, we need an SP metadata file and test user.

mina-solutions: Can someone assemble a 1‑page runbook + two code snippets (JS mux sample + curl non-stream fallback) by EOD? I can send the SOC2 pdf to security@redwood.ai today.

anne-devex: I can draft runbook and the snippets — will add a short troubleshooting checklist (common mux errors, CORS/connectivity, token expiry handling).

ben-sales: I’ll prep a one-paragraph pricing note and commit suggestion for the demo.

sec-bot: Confirmed — will queue SOC2 triage after we get dataflow and contact.

mina-solutions: Awesome. If we can be ready by Wed EOD that gives time for legal to review before Thurs demo. Scheduling: 30m sync Wed 9am PT? :calendar: 

raj-eng: Works for me. :thumbsup:

anne-devex: Works. I’ll drop a calendar invite and attach the draft runbook once ready.

ben-sales: I’ll join and bring pricing slides.

mina-solutions: Thanks all — sending initial context + sample payloads to the channel in a minute. :rocket:
